class.name: TTSPersonaListSettings
class.brief_description: Settings resource of [TTSPersonaSettingsServer]: the player's text-to-speech personas.
class.description: The data of the settings domain [code]"tts_personas"[/code]: one [TTSPersonaSettings] per persona the player created or changed. The player's default persona is the entry with [member TTSPersonaSettings.default] set, so the resource holds nothing but the list and [TTSPersonaSettingsServer] can store it as CSV with one row per persona. [TTSPersonaSettingsServer] keeps three copies of it (defaults, applied and pending values, see [method SettingsServer.get_settings]); use the methods of [TTSPersonaSettingsServer] and [ListSettingsServer] to change the entries.

members.member: The entries, one per persona, identified by [member TTSPersonaSettings.persona_name].
